comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments with the same null and empty rules, but the constructs differ. Feature 0 counts any concrete real-world example (a specific case, event, person or organization), and it explicitly counts personal experience. Feature 1 requires specific empirical evidence: data, statistics, study findings, or documented cases with specific details. Feature 0 would count a bare named person or event or an anecdote used as an example. Feature 1 would not count these without concrete factual or empirical detail. Feature 1 would count statistics or study findings that are not a case or example. The eligibility boundaries therefore differ materially.
